title: Correct minimum length
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the minimum conveyor belt length l₀ = 3 m.

title: Correct scratch length
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the scratch length s = 6 m.

title: Acceleration analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly analyze the two acceleration phases, distinguishing between upward and downward motion relative to the belt.

title: Kinematic application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply kinematic equations to find times and displacements for each phase of motion.

title: Relative motion concept
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly interpret the scratch length as a relative motion problem between the block and the moving belt.

title: Friction direction
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly assumes friction direction remains constant throughout both sliding phases.

title: Sign errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes sign errors in acceleration equations or kinematic calculations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student maintains consistent units throughout calculations and presents final answers with correct units.
